text: シルフの　ビル　から　ロケットの　ボスが　にげて　いくの！

structure.jp: シルフの　ビル　から
ロケットの　ボスが

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says the action moves away from where the speaker is. にげて　いく = 'run off'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns the whole action into a thing, here the thing he saw in the line before. にげて　いくの = 'the running away'.
